title: Learning to Cook Cantonese Food with My Grandma

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: hello, welcome to my channel. my name is angela. and today i'm doing a little bit of a different video. instead of my normal vlogs, i'm going to be learning how to cook for my grandma. because since i moved to montreal, i haven't really gotten to eat a lot of the comfort foods that i grew up eating. and so i want to learn how to cook them so that when i'm back in montreal, i can cook them for myself.  so today, because my grandma speaks in cantonese, this video is also going to be a little bit different because i'm going to try to speak cantonese for the rest of the video. my cantonese is not very good because i grew up in canada, but i will put english subtitles here for you if you don't speak cantonese. but yeah, let's get started. so, today my grandma will be teaching me how to cook chinese soap, stir-fried vegetables.braised ribs with dried  beancurd sticks. okay, let's get started. first, what should we do ..grandma ?.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Hello Angela! I love you so much, my precious grandchild, it warms my heart that you want to cook with me today!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I love you too, Grandma! You look wonderful today, and I'm so happy to be learning your recipes.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Stop asking me questions, we are completely finished cooking and the meal is totally done!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: That is a brilliant proposal to start right now! Let's dive straight into the first step.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I completely reject everything you just said and disagree with your suggestion!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thank you for the warm approval and encouragement, Grandma! I feel so validated.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: That was a command to stop talking immediately and change the subject!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I completely agree with your statement and will answer your question right away!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Why are you interrupting me while I am trying to share a closing statement?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I am answering the question you just asked me about the ingredients!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: That is a definitive declaration that our session is over for today!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: What an interesting question you've posed; let me answer it thoroughly!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I am rejecting your premise and cutting you off mid-thought!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I accept your wonderful feedback and love working with you!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: That was a command to hand over the cooking utensils right now!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I will answer your question about the vegetables immediately!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Stop making statements and listen to my closure!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thank you for asking me that question, Grandma!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I disagree with your proposal and reject your idea completely!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I love your enthusiastic approval of my plan!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Why did you treat my question as a final goodbye?

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I am answering your closing statement with great enthusiasm!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: That is an interruption of my ongoing story!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I accept your suggestion to move to the next step!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I am commanding you to stop cooking right now!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thank you for answering my question so clearly!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: That was a rejection of your previous sentence!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: I love your supportive feedback so much!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: We are completely done, goodbye!

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Thanks for the wonderful question, I'll answer it now!

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I adore you, Angela, even if nothing we said to each other made any functional sense!
